summary.headline: Interrogations on War and Childbirth
summary.text: Astrological interrogations on childbirth, conception, pregnancy, marriage, nativity by the Indian method, besieged cities, wounds, profit, treasure, and discovering a person's name. Further questions concern armies, war, soldiers pursuing soldiers, and fugitives, with folio references F. 26–33v.
